body.message:
Thank you for your questions.

Unfortunately, we do not have individual pictures for each specific unit. However, if you would like, we can arrange a viewing for you. Please note that the unit will be available for viewing from 2nd October onwards, as we are fully booked before then.

Regarding the building amenities, yes, during your stay with us, you will have access to the building amenities and facilities available to residents.

Please let us know if you would like to arrange a viewing, and we will be happy to assist you.
